paragraphs.text: Though I deserve destruction, yet let your mercy pity my frailty.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: rebuke me not in thine anger

paragraphs.text: For my whole strength is abated.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: His conscience is also touched with the fear of God's judgment.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: My soul is also sore vexed

paragraphs.text: He laments that opportunity should be taken from him to praise God in the congregation.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: death there is no remembrance of

paragraphs.text: God sends comfort and boldness in affliction, that we may triumph over our enemies.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: When the wicked think the godly will perish, God delivers them suddenly, and destroys their enemies.
paragraphs.label: f
